page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The server provisions 32 virtual CPUs across 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity totals 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB allocation per vCPU. Hardware instruction support includes AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. This instance does not include bundled local storage or dedicated GPU accelerators, relying on remote block storage for data persistence, while offering a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark results illustrate a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. Single-core performance places in the lower quartile, reflected by a Geekbench single-core score of 951.0 and a stress-ng single-core result of 1106.88. Single-threaded gzip compression (19.05 GB/sec) and bzip3 decompression (7.46 GB/sec) also exhibit lower-tier efficiency. However, aggregate multi-threaded benchmarks demonstrate middle-tier scalability, evidenced by a multi-core stress-ng rating of 23406.46, a Geekbench multi-core score of 8312.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 23344.34. Memory throughput reaches 119.7 GB/sec for large-block uncached reads and 55.79 GB/sec for uncached writes.

The architecture trades high single-thread clock performance for parallel core utilization, making it cost-efficient for scale-out parallel workloads rather than clock-sensitive legacy applications. Database operations reach 8537.54 on PassMark, while Redis SET performance achieves 23.48 million operations per second. Static web serving throughput averages 14.04 GB/sec. Additionally, small-scale LLM prompt processing delivers 1272.29 tokens per second for a 135M model and 40.06 tokens per second for a 7B model. Recommended workloads include multi-threaded web application hosting, backend API services, Redis caching layers, and software compilation tasks.
description: The Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz across 16 physical cores. It provides 128.0 GB of memory, establishing a standard 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio, with a 15 Gbps baseline network capacity. The server lacks local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware, requiring attached network volumes. While single-thread benchmarks place in the lower tier (Geekbench single-core score of 951.0), parallel processing yields middle-tier performance across multi-core tests, such as a PassMark CPU score of 23,344.34 and a stress-ng multi-core result of 23,406.46. Cached memory bandwidth reaches 1,306.09 GB/sec, while Redis SET throughput achieves 23.48 million operations per second. This resource density makes the instance effective for multi-threaded enterprise applications, web microservices, compilation jobs, and in-memory caching systems.
